definitions.explanation: A large crowd of people moving like waves, especially the flow of a dense throng in a busy place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人波|ひとなみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧あふれて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The station was overflowing with a sea of people.

examples.japanese: {人波|ひとなみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧のまれて⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見失|みうしな}った→見失う：14129_miushinau⟧。
examples.english: I was swept up in the crowd and lost sight of my friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花火大会|はなびたいかい}→花火大会：10105_hanabitaikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{帰|かえ}り{道|みち}→帰り道：12447_kaerimichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧{人波|ひとなみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{進|すす}めなかった→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: On the way back from the fireworks show, the wave of people stretching to the station made it hard to move.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (people) + ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧ (wave). A vivid image of a crowd flowing and surging like the sea.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人波|ひとなみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧のまれる: to be swallowed up by the crowd
- {人波|ひとなみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かき{分|わ}ける→かき分ける：28182_kakiwakeru⟧: to push through the crowd
- {人波|ひとなみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる→押し寄せる：06733_oshiyoseru⟧: a wave of people surges in

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {人|ひと}ごみ: crowd; throng — the most common everyday word, emphasizes congestion
- ⟦{群衆|ぐんしゅう}→群衆：14930_gunshuu⟧: crowd; multitude — more formal, a mass of gathered people
